title.en: Make a decision, do the washing up
title.de: Feste Wendungen: make a decision, do the washing up
title.sl: Stalne zveze: make a decision, do the washing up
title.it: Le collocazioni: make a decision, do the washing up

goal.sl: Veš, kateri glagol gre s katerim samostalnikom (make a decision, do the washing up, take a photo, have a chat), kateri pridevnik s čim (heavy rain, strong tea) in razumeš vsakdanje britanske frazeme.
goal.de: Du weißt, welches Verb zu welchem Nomen gehört (make a decision, do the washing up, take a photo, have a chat), welches Adjektiv wozu (heavy rain, strong tea), und verstehst britische Redewendungen.
goal.it: Sai quale verbo va con quale nome (make a decision, do the washing up, take a photo, have a chat), quale aggettivo con che cosa (heavy rain, strong tea) e capisci i modi di dire britannici.
goal.en: You know which verb goes with which noun (make a decision, do the washing up, take a photo, have a chat), which adjective with what (heavy rain, strong tea), and you understand everyday British idioms.

say.sl: **make** gre s tem, kar nastane: **make a decision** (odločiti se), **a mistake** (napaka), **a noise** (hrup), **a phone call** (klic), **friends** (prijatelji), **an effort** (trud), **the bed** (postlati). Angleščina ima za *narediti* dva glagola. Britanci rečejo tudi **take a decision**.
say.de: **make** steht bei dem, was entsteht: **make a decision** (eine Entscheidung treffen), **a mistake** (Fehler), **a noise** (Lärm), **a phone call** (Anruf), **friends** (Freunde finden), **an effort** (Mühe), **the bed** (das Bett machen). Für *machen* hat Englisch zwei Verben. Briten sagen auch **take a decision**.
say.it: **make** va con ciò che nasce: **make a decision** (prendere una decisione), **a mistake** (errore), **a noise** (rumore), **a phone call** (telefonata), **friends** (fare amicizia), **an effort** (sforzo), **the bed** (rifare il letto). Per *fare* l'inglese ha due verbi. I britannici dicono anche **take a decision**.
say.en: **make** goes with what comes to be: **make a decision**, **a mistake**, **a noise**, **a phone call**, **friends**, **an effort**, **the bed**. Other languages often have one verb where English has two. The British also say **take a decision**.

examples.en: Jack had to make a decision.
The children are making a noise.

say.sl: **do** gre z delom in opravili: **do the washing up** (pomiti posodo), **the shopping** (nakupovanje), **the cooking** (kuhanje), **your homework** (naloga), **your best** (dati vse od sebe), **a favour** (usluga), **business** (posli). V slovenščini je vse to *narediti*, zato pazi: **I did my homework.**
say.de: **do** steht bei Arbeit und Aufgaben: **do the washing up** (abwaschen), **the shopping** (einkaufen), **the cooking** (kochen), **your homework** (Hausaufgaben), **your best** (sein Bestes geben), **a favour** (einen Gefallen tun), **business** (Geschäfte machen). Auf Deutsch ist vieles davon *machen*, also Achtung: **I did my homework.**
say.it: **do** va con i lavori e le faccende: **do the washing up** (lavare i piatti), **the shopping** (la spesa), **the cooking** (cucinare), **your homework** (i compiti), **your best** (fare del proprio meglio), **a favour** (un favore), **business** (affari). In italiano è quasi tutto *fare*, quindi attenzione: **I did my homework.**
say.en: **do** goes with work and jobs: **do the washing up**, **the shopping**, **the cooking**, **your homework**, **your best**, **a favour**, **business**. **I did my homework.** Americans say do the dishes, and so do many Britons.

say.sl: **take** je **take a photo** (fotografirati, po slovensko *narediti*), in **a seat** (sesti), **the bus** (peljati se z avtobusom), **your time** (ne hiteti), **care** (paziti), **a break** (odmor), **an exam** (izpit). Britansko tudi **sit an exam**. **Please take a seat.** (Izvolite sesti.)
say.de: **take** ist **take a photo** (ein Foto machen, auf Deutsch *machen*), und **a seat** (Platz nehmen), **the bus** (den Bus nehmen), **your time** (sich Zeit lassen), **care** (aufpassen), **a break** (Pause machen), **an exam** (Prüfung machen). Britisch auch **sit an exam**. **Please take a seat.** (Bitte nehmen Sie Platz.)
say.it: **take** è **take a photo** (fare una foto, in italiano *fare*), e **a seat** (sedersi), **the bus** (prendere l'autobus), **your time** (fare con calma), **care** (stare attento), **a break** (fare una pausa), **an exam** (dare un esame). In britannico anche **sit an exam**. **Please take a seat.** (Si accomodi, prego.)
say.en: **take** is for **take a photo**, whatever your own language says, and **a seat**, **the bus**, **your time**, **care**, **a break**, **an exam**. In Britain **sit an exam** too. **Please take a seat.**

say.sl: **have** gre s tem, kar doživiš ali ješ: **have a chat** (poklepetati), **a rest** (počitek), **a look** (pogled), **a go** (poskus, britansko), **a good time** (dobro se imeti), **a party** (zabava), **lunch** (kosilo), **a shower** (prha), **a bath** (kopel). Mnogo gre tudi s **take**, bolj ameriško: **take a shower**, **take a look**. Oboje je prav.
say.de: **have** steht bei dem, was du erlebst oder isst: **have a chat** (plaudern), **a rest** (Ruhe), **a look** (einen Blick), **a go** (einen Versuch, britisch), **a good time** (Spaß haben), **a party** (eine Party), **lunch** (zu Mittag essen), **a shower** (duschen), **a bath** (baden). Vieles geht auch mit **take**, eher amerikanisch: **take a shower**, **take a look**. Beides ist richtig.
say.it: **have** va con ciò che vivi o mangi: **have a chat** (fare due chiacchiere), **a rest** (riposarsi), **a look** (un'occhiata), **a go** (un tentativo, britannico), **a good time** (divertirsi), **a party** (una festa), **lunch** (pranzare), **a shower** (la doccia), **a bath** (il bagno). Molti vanno anche con **take**, più americano: **take a shower**, **take a look**. Vanno bene tutti e due.
say.en: **have** goes with what you enjoy, go through or eat: **have a chat**, **a rest**, **a look**, **a go** (British), **a good time**, **a party**, **lunch**, **a shower**, **a bath**. Many go with **take** too, more in America: **take a shower**, **take a look**. Both are right.

say.sl: Tudi pridevnik in samostalnik gresta skupaj po navadi: **heavy rain** (močan dež), **heavy traffic**, **heavy snow**; **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **strong coffee**; **thick fog** (gosta megla); **light rain** (rahel dež); **a close friend** (dober prijatelj); **a bad cold** (hud prehlad). Slovenski *močan dež* v angleščini ni strong.
say.de: Auch Adjektiv und Nomen gehören aus Gewohnheit zusammen: **heavy rain** (starker Regen), **heavy traffic**, **heavy snow**; **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **strong coffee**; **thick fog** (dichter Nebel); **light rain** (leichter Regen); **a close friend** (ein enger Freund); **a bad cold** (eine starke Erkältung). Deutsch *stark* ist bei Regen nicht strong.
say.it: Anche aggettivo e nome stanno insieme per abitudine: **heavy rain** (pioggia forte), **heavy traffic**, **heavy snow**; **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **strong coffee**; **thick fog** (nebbia fitta); **light rain** (pioggia leggera); **a close friend** (un amico stretto); **a bad cold** (un brutto raffreddore). *Forte* con la pioggia non è strong.
say.en: An adjective and a noun go together by habit too: **heavy rain**, **heavy traffic**, **heavy snow**; **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **strong coffee**; **thick fog**; **light rain**; **a close friend**; **a bad cold**. Rain is heavy, not strong.

say.sl: Frazema ne prevajaš besedo za besedo, spreminja se le glagol: **It's raining cats and dogs.** (Lije kot iz škafa.) **It was raining cats and dogs.** Še: **a piece of cake** (mala malica), **under the weather** (ni mi dobro), **over the moon** (v sedmih nebesih), **a storm in a teacup** (vihar v kozarcu vode), **once in a blue moon** (enkrat na sto let).
say.de: Eine Redewendung übersetzt du nicht Wort für Wort, nur das Verb ändert sich: **It's raining cats and dogs.** (Es schüttet wie aus Eimern.) **It was raining cats and dogs.** Auch: **a piece of cake** (ein Kinderspiel), **under the weather** (nicht ganz gesund), **over the moon** (im siebten Himmel), **a storm in a teacup** (ein Sturm im Wasserglas), **once in a blue moon** (alle heiligen Zeiten).
say.it: Un modo di dire non si traduce parola per parola, cambia solo il verbo: **It's raining cats and dogs.** (Piove a catinelle.) **It was raining cats and dogs.** Anche: **a piece of cake** (una passeggiata), **under the weather** (non sto tanto bene), **over the moon** (al settimo cielo), **a storm in a teacup** (una tempesta in un bicchier d'acqua), **once in a blue moon** (ogni morte di papa).
say.en: An idiom isn't said word by word, and only its verb changes: **It's raining cats and dogs.** **It was raining cats and dogs.** Also: **a piece of cake** (very easy), **under the weather** (not very well), **over the moon** (very happy), **a storm in a teacup** (a fuss about little), **once in a blue moon** (very rarely).

exercises.text: Last Saturday Jack ___ a big mistake: he left the gate open. He ___ his best to find the sheep, and he ___ the bus to Keswick to ask about them. There he ___ a long chat with a farmer. In the end he ___ a decision: a new gate. That evening he ___ the washing up at the inn and ___ a rest by the fire.

translation.sl: Prejšnjo soboto je Jack naredil veliko napako: pustil je odprta vrata pašnika. Dal je vse od sebe, da bi našel ovce, in se z avtobusom odpeljal v Keswick vprašat zanje. Tam je dolgo klepetal s kmetom. Na koncu se je odločil: nova vrata. Tisti večer je v gostilni pomil posodo in počival ob ognju.
translation.de: Letzten Samstag machte Jack einen großen Fehler: Er ließ das Gatter offen. Er gab sein Bestes, um die Schafe zu finden, und nahm den Bus nach Keswick, um nach ihnen zu fragen. Dort plauderte er lange mit einem Bauern. Am Ende traf er eine Entscheidung: ein neues Gatter. An dem Abend wusch er im Gasthaus ab und ruhte sich am Feuer aus.
translation.it: Sabato scorso Jack ha fatto un grosso errore: ha lasciato aperto il cancello. Ha fatto del suo meglio per trovare le pecore e ha preso l'autobus per Keswick per chiedere di loro. Lì ha fatto una lunga chiacchierata con un contadino. Alla fine ha preso una decisione: un cancello nuovo. Quella sera ha lavato i piatti alla locanda e si è riposato vicino al fuoco.
translation.en: Last Saturday Jack made a big mistake: he left the gate open. He did his best to find the sheep, and he took the bus to Keswick to ask about them. There he had a long chat with a farmer. In the end he made a decision: a new gate. That evening he did the washing up at the inn and had a rest by the fire.

exercises.text: It rained all night: very ___ rain. In the morning there was ___ fog, and you couldn't see the road. Mrs Birkett made some ___ tea, not weak at all. Jack said the walk home was a piece of ___, but the next day he was ___ the weather.

translation.sl: Vso noč je deževalo: zelo močan dež. Zjutraj je bila gosta megla in ceste se ni videlo. Gospa Birkett je skuhala močan čaj, sploh ne šibkega. Jack je rekel, da je bila pot domov mala malica, a naslednji dan mu ni bilo dobro.
translation.de: Es regnete die ganze Nacht: sehr starker Regen. Am Morgen war dichter Nebel, und man sah die Straße nicht. Mrs Birkett machte starken Tee, gar nicht schwach. Jack sagte, der Heimweg sei ein Kinderspiel gewesen, aber am nächsten Tag war er nicht ganz auf der Höhe.
translation.it: Ha piovuto tutta la notte: una pioggia fortissima. La mattina c'era una nebbia fitta e non si vedeva la strada. La signora Birkett ha fatto un tè forte, per niente leggero. Jack ha detto che tornare a casa è stata una passeggiata, ma il giorno dopo non stava tanto bene.
translation.en: It rained all night: very heavy rain. In the morning there was thick fog, and you couldn't see the road. Mrs Birkett made some strong tea, not weak at all. Jack said the walk home was a piece of cake, but the next day he was under the weather.
